name: writers-room
description: Plan a book or a whole series in plain conversation while Claude keeps your story bible, character sheets and outline up to date, then build chapters with a draft, critique and revise press on your own model provider.

library.title: Library folder
library.description: Where your books live. Leave empty to keep them in a 'library' folder inside the folder you're working in.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used to build chapters and for second opinions. One key reaches every model. Get one at openrouter.ai/keys.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional: Claude models directly from Anthropic. With no OpenRouter key, the roles use it by themselves.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Optional: GPT models directly from OpenAI. With no OpenRouter key, the roles use it by themselves.

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: Optional: Gemini models directly from Google. With no OpenRouter key, the roles use it by themselves.
